$comment: Social surface group (redesign Pass 2 on Retro, 2026-10-16): chat.thread, chat.composer, chat.voice, chat.reactions, photo.viewer, viewer.selfiereaction (new-features consolidation, 2026-10-16), walls.mine, walls.member, walls.browse, week.recap, week.edit, week.history, albums.list, albums.view. Only values Retro (or a mechanics reference) measured for these surfaces live here; everything else is a global.* token or a design/components.md component named in design/surfaces/<id>.md. Decisions: design/MERGE_DECISIONS.md → Redesign — Social (RS-*).

chat.thread.dimension.rowAvatarToText.element: message row (C-16 comment row): avatar right edge → name / text ink
chat.thread.dimension.rowAvatarToText.evidence: references/auto/retro/press/tc-2023-07-retro-2b.jpg (viewer comment row 'elton 2h / whoa!': avatar x 1356–1423, text ink from x 1460)
chat.thread.dimension.rowAvatarToText.method: run edges, 37 px ÷ 2.209 px/pt — TC-2B phone 2 at 2.209 px/pt (the full-width photo spans x 1320–2188 = 868 px = 393 pt; the 16-pt field margins and the 8.6-pt home-indicator offset agree)
chat.thread.dimension.rowAvatarToText.notes: Not in design/components.md C-16 (it names sizes only). The viewer comments (photo.viewer) and the chat thread use the same row. Avatar top aligns with the name line's ascender (avatar y 1704 vs ink 1701).

chat.thread.dimension.rowLinePitch.element: message row: baseline of the name / time line → baseline of the first text line (and text line → text line)
chat.thread.dimension.rowLinePitch.method: 42 px ÷ 2.209 px/pt — TC-2B phone 2 at 2.209 px/pt (the full-width photo spans x 1320–2188 = 868 px = 393 pt; the 16-pt field margins and the 8.6-pt home-indicator offset agree)
chat.thread.dimension.rowLinePitch.notes: Equals the 15-pt body role's line pitch on iOS; multi-line message text keeps this pitch.

chat.thread.dimension.itemGap.element: gap between stacked items inside one run (text block, photo card, voice capsule, post attachment, reaction chip)
chat.thread.dimension.itemGap.evidence: references/auto/retro/web/retro.app-42b38811bebcd07d.css (.immersiveViewer_mediaFooterText__0UFYr{…gap:.5rem}: the stacked lines of Retro's viewer footer)

chat.thread.duration.entry.notes: Reduce Motion: the row appears without a fade (layout.global.reduceMotion keeps fades; this one is a cross-fade of the same duration, allowed).

chat.thread.easing.entry.element: curve of the message entry animation
chat.thread.easing.entry.evidence: references/auto/retro/apk/retro-android-2026.10.1150-excerpts.txt (m6a.java:1509 tween easing qh4.d); design/research/retro-package-copy-motion.md §3.7 ('tween 250 ms Linear — "entry animation" (message thread)')

chat.thread.layout.timeFormat.element: time on a run's first row and the day dividers of the thread

chat.thread.layout.replyQuote.evidence: references/auto/retro/apk/retro-android-2026.10.1150-strings.txt (message_thread_post_attachment_title_template 'Post by %1$s', message_thread_post_subtitle_week_template 'Week %1$d', message_thread_reply_default_text 'Message', message_thread_reply_default_text_attachment 'Attachment', message_thread_context_menu_reply 'Reply'); design/components.md C-15 (row with thumbnail; subtitle with the actor's name in semibold, 'daniel shared 2 posts')

value.rows: two rows: the C-13 field, then the controls row size.global.pillGap below it, inside size.global.screenMargin
value.fieldRecording: icon.global.mic in color.global.destructive at the avatar's place · elapsed time (chat.voice.layout.durationFormat, text role body, monospaced, color.global.textPrimary) · C-36 live waveform across the rest of the field to the trailing glyph inset (chat.composer.dimension.glyphInsetTrailing)
value.fieldPaused: icon.global.play (previewing: icon.global.pause) in color.global.textPrimary at the avatar's place (a button) · C-36 draft waveform with the preview's progress · the draft's length (preview: elapsed), text role body, monospaced, at the trailing glyph inset
value.controls: leading: icon.global.trash in color.global.destructive (bare glyph, size.global.headerButton hit) aligned with the field's leading glyph; centre: C-11 circle on the page (size.global.circleButton, color.global.control) holding icon.global.pause (recording) or icon.global.mic (paused) in color.global.destructive; trailing: C-11 circle in the primary fill (color.global.accent, icon.global.send in color.global.onAccent) aligned with the field's trailing glyph
value.pause: recording → paused: the recorder pauses; the draft's waveform and length show
value.continue: paused → recording: the recording continues at the end of the draft
value.preview: paused: the glyph plays / pauses the draft from its start; continuing or sending stops the preview
value.discard: trash: the recording is deleted (no confirmation, as WhatsApp and Messages)
value.send: send: recording or paused, the whole recording is sent
value.onMedia: camera.sendto: the same order inside the recording capsule (camera.sendto.layout.messageField)
value.motion: rows appear / change with duration.global.fade; the live waveform redraws per sample without animation
